spanish: Y alma, cuando tocare en todo impuro, en impureza de hombre o en animal impuro o en toda abominación impura, y comiere desde carne de sacrificio de los pazes que a Jehová, y será cortada el alma aquella desde sus pueblos.
grammarChanges: adam -> hombre: supplied the missing Spanish common noun for אָדָם (h03007021007), which the draft had left untranslated.

abominable -> abominación: supplied the missing nominal head for שֶׁקֶץ (h03007021013), since 'abominable' is only an adjective; adjusted 'todo' to 'toda' and 'impuro' to 'impura' for agreement with the new feminine noun.
readerNote: comiere is left unchanged for the h03007021015 warn because Spanish finite verb forms (unlike participles) do not inflect for subject gender, so no grammatical repair is available.
